raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

With `load_format=dummy`, the dummy loader writes random values into the attention KV-cache scales. Checkpoints without KV-cache scales never overwrite them, so after a dummy start and a weight sync (the usual RL startup) they still differ from a real start. This PR makes dummy loading write the same values a real start has. Part of the direct weight reload work (#54477).

## Claims

- **Dummy start + sync now matches a real start for the attention scales.** The `KVCacheScaleParameter` scales (`q/k/v/prob_scale`) get the `-1.0` "not loaded" sentinel, the `_q/_k/_v/_prob_scale` buffers get `1.0`, and the compressed-tensors `q/k/v_scale` / zero points get `1.0` / `0.0`, all through the existing `dummy_weight_value` attribute. Post-load processing then takes the same "no checkpoint scales" path as on a real start.
- On Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8 (TP4, `VLLM_RELOAD_MODE=direct`), the attention tensors that differ from a fresh real start after a dummy start + 1 sync drop from 1152 to 0 (auto KV cache) and from 768 to 0 (FP8 KV cache).
- Real (non-dummy) loading is unchanged: only the dummy loader reads `dummy_weight_value`.

## Validation

GB200, nightly wheel of d3a3230931 with this branch's Python files on top.

**Unit test**: `tests/quantization/test_fp8.py::test_dummy_load_keeps_kv_cache_scales_of_real_start[auto|fp8 × base|compressed_tensors]` (new, CPU-only). It builds a layer with real-start scales and one loaded by `DummyModelLoader`, runs post-load processing on both, and asserts exact equality of the state dict, the host float scales and the CPU scale copies.

| | main (job 44564) | this PR (job 44565) |
|---|---|---|
| new test, 4 cases | 4 failed: e.g. `_k_scale` expected 1.0, got -0.000942 (auto); `k_scale` expected -1.0, got -0.000942 (fp8) | 4 passed |
| `test_fp8.py -k "kv_cache or dummy or scale"` | | 25 passed |
| `test_compressed_tensors.py -k "kv_cache or attn_head"` | | 2 passed |
| `test_weight_utils.py` | | 57 passed |

```
pytest tests/quantization/test_fp8.py -k test_dummy_load_keeps_kv_cache_scales_of_real_start
```

**End to end**: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8, TP4, `VLLM_RELOAD_MODE=direct`, `--max-model-len 4096 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.5`. A fresh real start is snapshotted, then a `--load-format dummy` start takes one full IPC weight sync from the same checkpoint. Every device tensor is compared with the fresh snapshot (runtime state excluded). GSM8K is 5-shot greedy over 1319 questions. A = main (d3a3230931), B = this PR, same node, back to back.

| KV cache | Arm | Tensors differing from fresh (dummy + 1 sync) | GSM8K real start | GSM8K dummy + 1 sync |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| auto | A (main) | **1152**: `{q,k,v,prob}_scale`, `_k_scale`, `_v_scale` × 48 layers × 4 ranks | 0.9030 | 0.8999 |
| auto | B (this PR) | **0** | 0.8984 | 0.8984 |
| fp8 | A (main) | **768**: `{q,k,v,prob}_scale` × 48 layers × 4 ranks | 0.8908 | 0.8863 |
| fp8 | B (this PR) | **0** | 0.8870 | 0.8870 |

A real start + 1 sync matches the fresh snapshot in both arms. GSM8K is within noise (main real starts range 0.899–0.908 across runs).

**CI**: the NVIDIA Quantization step in `.buildkite/test_areas/quantization.yaml` is commented out on main ("Disabled until torchao transitive dependencies are locked"), so CI will not run the new test on NVIDIA until it is re-enabled. The AMD mirror is commented out with it. The test needs no GPU.

## Details

**Root cause.** `DummyModelLoader` fills every parameter and persistent buffer through `initialize_single_dummy_weight`, which writes random values unless the tensor sets `dummy_weight_value`. The attention scales are never in a checkpoint without KV-cache scales:

- `q/k/v/prob_scale` (`KVCacheScaleParameter`) are created as `-1.0`, the sentinel post-load processing reads as "not loaded, use the default". After a dummy load they hold a random value. With one seed, that value is the same for all of them.
- `_q/_k/_v/_prob_scale` are persistent buffers registered at `1.0` by `set_default_quant_scales`. With an unquantized KV cache, post-load processing rewrites `_q_scale` and `_prob_scale` but not `_k_scale` / `_v_scale`, so those kept the dummy value.
- Compressed-tensors `q/k/v_scale` are created as `1.0` (zero points `0.0`) and used directly as the scales. A checkpoint without a `kv_cache_scheme` never writes them, so with an FP8 KV cache the random value became the scale.

A weight sync from such a checkpoint never writes these tensors, so the dummy values outlived it. Layerwise reload used to hide this by recreating the scales on every reload; direct reload writes in place and exposed it.

**Fix.** The fix sets `dummy_weight_value` to each tensor's creation value, the mechanism layernorm and ModelOpt already use:

- a class attribute on `KVCacheScaleParameter`, covering every method that uses `BaseKVCacheMethod.create_weights` (Fp8, ModelOpt, Quark, ...);
- the buffers in `set_default_quant_scales`, covering Attention, MLAAttention and the models that call it directly;
- `set_weight_attrs` in `CompressedTensorsKVCacheMethod.create_weights`.

On main, a dummy start with an FP8 KV cache kept GSM8K only because the shared random value happened to be negative and took the fallback to 1.0 (`_k_scale` / `_v_scale` match in the FP8 run above). A positive value would have become the KV-cache scale.

---

 from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.fp8 import (

     process_fp8_input_tensor_strategy_moe,

 from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.weight_utils import default_weight_loader

@@ -896,6 +902,39 @@ def test_kv_cache_scale_sync_to_host_copies():
     assert layer._v_scale_cpu.item() == pytest.approx(layer._v_scale.item())
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("method_cls", ["base", "compressed_tensors"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kv_cache_dtype", ["auto", "fp8"])
+def test_dummy_load_keeps_kv_cache_scales_of_real_start(kv_cache_dtype, method_cls):
+    """KV-cache scales missing from the checkpoint must match a real start after
+    a dummy load: no later weight sync from that checkpoint rewrites them.
+    """
+
+    def start(load_format: str) -> torch.nn.Module:
+        layer = torch.nn.Module()
+        set_default_quant_scales(layer, register_buffer=True)
+        layer.kv_cache_dtype = kv_cache_dtype
+        if method_cls == "base":
+            method = BaseKVCacheMethod(quant_config=None)
+        else:
+            config = CompressedTensorsConfig(
+                target_scheme_map={}, ignore=[], quant_format="float-quantized"
+            )
+            method = CompressedTensorsKVCacheMethod(config)
+        method.create_weights(layer)
+        if load_format == "dummy":
+            loader = DummyModelLoader(LoadConfig(load_format=load_format))
+            loader.load_weights(layer, model_config=None)
+        method.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+        return layer
+
+    real, dummy = start("auto"), start("dummy")
+    torch.testing.assert_close(dummy.state_dict(), real.state_dict(), rtol=0, atol=0)
+    for name in ("_q_scale_float", "_k_scale_float", "_v_scale_float"):
+        assert getattr(dummy, name) == getattr(real, name), name
+    for name in ("_k_scale_cpu", "_v_scale_cpu"):
+        assert torch.equal(getattr(dummy, name), getattr(real, name)), name
+
+
 @pytest.mark.skipif(
     not is_quant_method_supported("fp8"),
     reason="FP8 is not supported on this GPU type.",

@@ -137,6 +137,9 @@ def set_default_quant_scales(layer: nn.Module, register_buffer: bool = False) ->
         layer.register_buffer("_v_scale", torch.tensor(1.0, dtype=torch.float32))
         layer.register_buffer("_q_scale", torch.tensor(1.0, dtype=torch.float32))
         layer.register_buffer("_prob_scale", torch.tensor(1.0, dtype=torch.float32))
+        # Checkpoints never hold these; dummy loading must keep the default.
+        for name in ("_k_scale", "_v_scale", "_q_scale", "_prob_scale"):
+            getattr(layer, name).dummy_weight_value = 1.0
     else:
         layer._k_scale.fill_(1.0)
         layer._v_scale.fill_(1.0)

@@ -73,6 +73,7 @@
     ParallelLMHead,
     VocabParallelEmbedding,
 )
+from vllm.model_executor.utils import set_weight_attrs
 from vllm.platforms import current_platform
 
 if TYPE_CHECKING:
@@ -1179,6 +1180,14 @@ def create_weights(self, layer: torch.nn.Module):
         layer.q_zero_point = torch.nn.Parameter(
             torch.zeros(n_scales, requires_grad=False)
         )
+        # Checkpoints may omit these; dummy loading must keep the defaults.
+        for kind in ("k", "v", "q"):
+            set_weight_attrs(
+                getattr(layer, f"{kind}_scale"), {"dummy_weight_value": 1.0}
+            )
+            set_weight_attrs(
+                getattr(layer, f"{kind}_zero_point"), {"dummy_weight_value": 0.0}
+            )
 
         # TP-aware loading for attn_head strategy follows attention head partitioning:
         # - q_scale is partitioned over query heads.

@@ -29,6 +29,10 @@ class KVCacheScaleParameter(torch.nn.Parameter):
     class-level loader.
     """
 
+    # Dummy loading writes the sentinel too: checkpoints without these scales
+    # never overwrite them, so random values would outlive later weight syncs.
+    dummy_weight_value = -1.0
+
     def __new__(cls) -> "KVCacheScaleParameter":
         return super().__new__(cls, torch.tensor(-1.0), requires_grad=False)
